cells.gaps: No delivery of accessible services by a government body is found. Sources disagree on when the National Digital Accessibility Policy took effect: December 2024 (LBY-004) or mandatory compliance from January 2026 (LBY-002); it is in force on either.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-11-03 (messages-for-bill 66: an academic audit alone does not answer question 4): the September 2026 paper is set aside. The National Digital Accessibility Policy, based on WCAG 2.2, is in force (LBY-004), so 3.
